question_stem_en: E-mail
notes: Open-ended (short text).

question_stem_en: Please indicate your current status.
explanatory_text_en: Note: Select only one option.
answer_options_en: I am a medical doctor.|I am not a medical doctor. (In 2025-2026, only medical doctors are accepted. Please visit our website to follow current announcements.)
notes: Eligibility screen; not carried into the analysis dataset.

question_stem_en: Date of birth - as year (4-digit number - YYYY)
notes: Open-ended (year - YYYY). Source of birth_year -> age -> age10.

question_stem_en: Biological sex
explanatory_text_en: Note: Select only one option.
answer_options_en: Female|Male
notes: Item wording is "biological sex" (biyolojik cinsiyet); no other category offered.

question_stem_en: Province of the institution where you work (license-plate no. - 2 digits)
notes: Open-ended (plate no. 01-81). Province of WORK, not residence.

question_stem_en: District of the institution where you work
notes: Open-ended (text). Not present in any supplied analysis file.

question_stem_en: Institution / unit where you work
explanatory_text_en: Note: Select only one option.
answer_options_en: Ministry of Health: Central - Provincial Health Directorate - District Health Directorate - 112 Command Control Unit|Ministry of Health: Family Health Center|Ministry of Health - Hospital|University (public or foundation) - Hospital|Private Hospital / Clinic
notes: 5 options; the first option bundles four distinct MoH administrative units into one code.

question_stem_en: Current job title
explanatory_text_en: Note: Select only one option.
answer_options_en: General practitioner|Resident physician (main or subspecialty)|Specialist / subspecialty specialist physician|Physician holding an academic title

question_stem_en: Participation in patient examination
explanatory_text_en: Note: Considering the last 3 months. Select only one option.
answer_options_en: Physician performing primary (face-to-face) patient examination -> go to Q10|Physician not performing primary (face-to-face) examination - non-clinical field or consultant (no direct patient contact) -> go to Q16
notes: BRANCHING ITEM. Only the first branch is asked Q10-Q15; the second skips to Q16.

question_stem_en: Working in a unit with high transmission risk
explanatory_text_en: Note: Select only one option.
answer_options_en: Emergency Department|Infectious Diseases and Clinical Microbiology|Chest Diseases (Pulmonology)|Anesthesiology and Reanimation / Intensive Care|Otorhinolaryngology (ENT)|Pediatrics|Family Medicine|None
notes: Asked only of the face-to-face branch (n=112 of 248 reporters). Single-select although a physician could work across units.

question_stem_en: Primary patient group (more than 80% of patients)
explanatory_text_en: Note: Select only one option.
answer_options_en: Children|Adults|65 years and older|Immunosuppressed
notes: n=112 branch. The 80% rule is the item's own definition of "primary".

question_stem_en: Considering the average of the last 3 months, number of patients primarily examined per day
explanatory_text_en: Note: In other words: with how many patients on average do you spend more than 2 minutes in the same room per day? Pediatrics: excluding patient companions. Do not count patients on whom procedures are performed under sterile operating-room conditions. If your contact time with inpatients during rounds is very short, do not include them.
notes: n=112 branch. The explanatory text defines exposure as >2 minutes shared-room contact, i.e. a contact-time proxy, not a workload count.

question_stem_en: In what percentage of your examinations do aerosol-generating procedures (intubation, bronchoscopy, respiratory sampling, etc.) occur in your daily practice?
explanatory_text_en: Note: Select only one option.
answer_options_en: Never|Less than 10%|10-20%|More than 20%
notes: n=112 branch. A SHARE of examinations, not an absolute number of procedures.

question_stem_en: Considering the average of the last 3 months, write the number of on-call shifts per month for which you are primarily responsible (following patients face-to-face)
explanatory_text_en: Note: Do not include consultant / on-call (icap) shifts. If you do not take shifts, write 0.
notes: n=112 branch. Explicitly excludes consultant/icap shifts.

question_stem_en: Considering the last month, do you use a mask while examining patients primarily (face-to-face)?
explanatory_text_en: Note: Select only one option.
answer_options_en: Yes|No
notes: n=112 branch. One-month recall; no frequency or mask-type gradation.

question_stem_en: Including yourself, how many people live in your household?
explanatory_text_en: Note: HOUSEHOLD DEFINITION: A group of one or more persons living at the same address, whether or not related. Select only one option.
answer_options_en: I live alone.|2|3|4|5|6 or more
notes: Top-coded at 6+.

question_stem_en: How many children in the household attend school (nursery, kindergarten, primary, middle, high school, university)?
explanatory_text_en: Note: If there are no children, or no school-attending children, in the household, write "0". Include your university-attending children in the total if they live with you.
notes: The item's own definition of "school" spans nursery through UNIVERSITY, so the count is not confined to school-age children in the epidemiological sense.

question_stem_en: Mark the conditions you have that pose a high risk for complications of influenza or COVID-19.
explanatory_text_en: Note: Multiple answers may be selected. Check all that apply.
answer_options_en: None (excludes the other options)|Respiratory system diseases: Asthma; chronic lung disease (COPD; cystic fibrosis; bronchiectasis, etc.)|Neurological diseases (epilepsy; cerebral palsy; spina bifida; history of stroke, etc.); disabilities with impaired muscle/lung function or swallowing difficulty|Blood diseases (sickle-cell anemia, etc.)|Endocrine disorders (diabetes, etc.)|Metabolic disorders (inherited metabolic diseases; mitochondrial diseases)|Mental disorders (depression; schizophrenia-spectrum disorder, etc.)|Heart disease (congenital heart disease; heart failure; coronary artery disease)|Kidney disease|Liver disease|Morbid obesity (BMI >=40 kg/m2)|Immune weakness due to disease (HIV/AIDS; cancers such as leukemia; autoimmune diseases; inherited immunodeficiencies)|Immune weakness due to medication (chemotherapy; radiotherapy; chronic steroids; immunosuppressive drugs - organ transplant; autoimmune diseases)|Pregnancy: first trimester (weeks 1-12)|Pregnancy: second trimester (weeks 13-28)|Pregnancy: third trimester (week 29 - birth)|I prefer not to answer|Other: ___
notes: MULTI-SELECT, 18 options incl. an explicit "I prefer not to answer" and a free-text "Other". Self-declared; no clinical verification. Pregnancy is offered as a comorbidity category.

question_stem_en: Do one or more household members carry a high risk for complications of influenza or COVID-19?
explanatory_text_en: Note: HIGH-RISK CONDITIONS: children under 2; people 65 and older; pregnant women; asthma; chronic lung disease; neurological diseases; disabilities with impaired muscle/lung function or swallowing difficulty; blood diseases; endocrine disorders (diabetes); metabolic disorders; mental disorders; heart disease; kidney disease; liver disease; morbid obesity (BMI >=40); long-term aspirin/salicylate use under age 19; immune weakness due to disease or medication. Select only one option.
answer_options_en: Yes|No|I live alone|I prefer not to answer
notes: The high-risk list here differs from Q18: it adds age <2, age >=65 and long-term aspirin use. "I live alone" is a distinct option, not a missing value.

question_stem_en: Public transport: average time spent in public transport per day
explanatory_text_en: Note: Select only one option.
answer_options_en: I generally don't use public transport|0-30 minutes|31-60 minutes|61-90 minutes|More than 90 minutes
notes: 5 options as fielded. The analysis file collapses 31-60 and 61-90 into a single "31-90" level.

question_stem_en: Excluding health care, mark your close-contact status with people in your social life outside the household (EXCLUDING HOUSEHOLD and PATIENTS; e.g., shopping, public transport, coworkers, students).
explanatory_text_en: Note: Close-contact definition: spending more than 15 minutes within 2 meters over a 24-hour period. You may select more than one answer. If you teach, university students fall within the 18-65 age range.
answer_options_en: I have close contact with more than 10 people aged 18-65 during the day.|I have close contact with more than 10 children or adolescents during the day.|I have close contact with more than 10 people aged 65 and over during the day.|None
notes: MULTI-SELECT. Each option is a >10-persons-per-day THRESHOLD, not a count; contacts at or below 10 are indistinguishable from none.

question_stem_en: Mark the option about tobacco-product use that applies to you.
explanatory_text_en: Note: If you use a tobacco product every day, write the PACK-YEAR NUMBER on the "Other:" line. Example: 3 packs/day for 10 years = 10x3 = 30; half a pack/day for 5 years = 5x0.5 = 2.5. Select only one option.
answer_options_en: I never used (I smoked fewer than 100 cigarettes in my lifetime)|I used to use (100+ cigarettes; not now) - Quit: 1 year ago|I used to use (100+ cigarettes; not now) - Quit: 1-5 years|I used to use (100+ cigarettes; not now) - Quit: >5 years|I use occasionally (some days a week; not every day)|Other: ___ (pack-year number)
notes: No explicit "I smoke daily" option: daily smokers are instructed to enter a pack-year NUMBER in the free-text "Other" line, so daily use must be inferred from a numeric entry.

question_stem_en: Allergy causing respiratory symptoms
explanatory_text_en: Note: Allergic rhinitis, hay fever (pollen), house dust/mites, pets, etc. Select only one option.
answer_options_en: Yes|No

question_stem_en: How often per year do you have an influenza-like illness?
explanatory_text_en: Note: Consider the average of the last 3 years. Select only one option.
answer_options_en: Never|1-2 times a year|3-4 times a year|5-6 times a year|More than 6 times a year
notes: THE SUSCEPTIBILITY ITEM. A 3-year-average self-recall of ILI frequency; no case definition is attached to the word "influenza-like illness" here (the ILI definition appears only on the weekly form).

question_stem_en: Whether you presented to a health-care facility for an influenza-like illness during Sep 2024 - Sep 2025
explanatory_text_en: Note: Select only one option.
answer_options_en: I did not have an influenza-like illness requiring treatment.|I managed my own treatment; I did not present to a health-care facility last year.|I made at least one outpatient visit (excluding the emergency department) last year for a colleague's elective opinion.|I presented to the emergency department at least once and did not need inpatient treatment.|I received inpatient treatment at least once.
notes: 5 options ordered by care intensity. Option 1 also carries the information "no prior-season ILI requiring treatment", so this single item encodes BOTH prior-ILI occurrence and care level.

question_stem_en: Flu Vaccine: Did you get a flu shot last season (2024-2025)?
explanatory_text_en: Note: Select only one option.
answer_options_en: No - I was not vaccinated.|Yes - I was vaccinated with the vaccine provided by my institution.|Yes - I was vaccinated with a vaccine obtained from a pharmacy.
notes: 3 options; the two "Yes" options distinguish the procurement route (institution vs pharmacy).

question_stem_en: Flu Vaccine: If you were vaccinated THIS SEASON (from September 2025 onward), mark your vaccination date.
explanatory_text_en: Note: Select only one option.
answer_options_en: No - I was not vaccinated.|Week 40: 29 Sep - 5 Oct 2025|Week 41: 6 - 12 Oct 2025|Week 42: 13 - 19 Oct 2025|Week 43: 20 - 26 Oct 2025|Week 44: 27 Oct - 2 Nov 2025|Week 45: 3 - 9 Nov 2025|Week 46: 10 - 16 Nov 2025|Week 47: 17 - 23 Nov 2025|Week 48: 24 - 30 Nov 2025|Week 49: 1 - 7 Dec 2025|Week 50: 8 - 14 Dec 2025|Week 51: 15 - 21 Dec 2025|Week 52: 22 - 28 Dec 2025|Week 1: 29 Dec 2025 - 4 Jan 2026|Week 2: 5 - 11 Jan 2026|Week 3: 12 - 18 Jan 2026|Week 4: 19 - 25 Jan 2026
notes: Vaccination status AND week in one item; the response set stops at W4/2026, so a vaccination after week 4 cannot be recorded on the registration form.

question_stem_en: Do you do at least 150 minutes of moderate-intensity, or at least 75 minutes of vigorous-intensity, aerobic physical activity per week in total?
explanatory_text_en: Note: Consider the average of the last month. Light: can talk and sing comfortably. Moderate: can talk but singing is hard. Vigorous: can speak only in short sentences. Select only one option.
answer_options_en: Yes|No
notes: WHO-threshold physical-activity item with a talk-test intensity definition; one-month recall.

question_stem_en: ID
explanatory_text_en: Note: Your unique identifier number - automatically assigned by the system. Please move on to the next question.
notes: Automatically assigned by the system (not filled in by the participant).

question_stem_en: In the past week, did you have symptoms of an INFLUENZA-LIKE ILLNESS?
explanatory_text_en: Note: At least one sudden-onset systemic symptom: fever or feverishness, malaise, myalgia, headache. At least one sudden-onset respiratory symptom: cough, sore throat, shortness of breath. Select only one option.
answer_options_en: YES -> go to Q3|NO (ends / submits the form)
notes: THE CASE DEFINITION lives in this note, not in the stem. The respondent self-applies it; no symptom checklist is collected, so the individual symptoms behind a YES are never recorded.

question_stem_en: When you evaluate your symptoms based on your clinical experience, which of the following do you think could be causing them?
explanatory_text_en: Note: Cluster A (Viral - Systemic effect): fever, myalgia, headache, malaise - Influenza, SARS-CoV-2. Cluster B (Viral - Local effect): rhinorrhea, sneezing, wheezing, conjunctivitis - Rhinovirus, RSV, Adenovirus, other respiratory viruses. Cluster C (Bacterial): high fever, purulent sputum/discharge, unilateral findings (otitis, sinusitis, tonsillitis), focal pneumonia. Cluster D: cannot distinguish / don't know from clinical experience. Select only one option.
answer_options_en: CLUSTER A (Viral - Systemic effect) -> go to Q4|CLUSTER B (Viral - Local effect)|CLUSTER C (Bacterial agents)|Cluster D: Cannot distinguish / Don't know
notes: The A/B/C/D scheme is a bespoke clinical-judgement classification with no external terminology mapping; it is an opinion, not a laboratory result. BRANCHING: only Cluster A continues to the severity block.

question_stem_en: Did your daily routine change because of your illness?
explanatory_text_en: Note: Why we ask: to gauge disease severity through loss of work capacity. Select only one option.
answer_options_en: No, it didn't change - I continued my daily activities as usual|Yes - but I COULD NOT TAKE TIME OFF WORK|Yes - I TOOK TIME OFF WORK: outpatient follow-up and treatment|Yes - I TOOK TIME OFF WORK: inpatient follow-up and treatment
notes: Asked ONLY of A-cluster weeks, so severity is measured on the influenza-like subset only.

question_stem_en: Did you use medication to relieve your symptoms?
explanatory_text_en: Note: Why we ask: to gauge disease severity through the need for treatment. You may select more than one answer.
answer_options_en: I did not need to use medication|Outpatient follow-up and treatment: NSAIDs (e.g., paracetamol; ibuprofen; aspirin, etc.)|Outpatient follow-up and treatment: Antiviral drugs (e.g., oseltamivir)|Outpatient follow-up and treatment: Antibiotics|Inpatient follow-up and treatment
notes: MULTI-SELECT; A-cluster weeks only.

question_stem_en: How many days did your symptoms last?
explanatory_text_en: Note: If still ongoing, write the total number of days since onset, including today.
notes: A-cluster weeks only. Right-censored by construction when the illness is ongoing at the time of the report.

question_stem_en: What is the likely source of your symptoms?
explanatory_text_en: Note: You may answer by considering people around you with similar symptoms. You may select more than one option.
answer_options_en: Health-care related (hospital; clinic; patient contact, etc.)|Contact with a household member who has symptoms|Contact with another source outside health care or the household (e.g., social setting)|Don't know / not sure
notes: MULTI-SELECT; A-cluster weeks only. Attribution is the respondent's inference, not a traced contact.

question_stem_en: DIAGNOSTIC TEST: Did you get tested for the causative agent?
explanatory_text_en: Note: Select only one option.
answer_options_en: I DID NOT GET TESTED|Not yet; but I plan to get tested soon|I HAD A PCR: Influenza Positive|I HAD A PCR: SARS-CoV-2 Positive|I had a PCR: Result NEGATIVE|I HAD A PCR: Influenza AND SARS-CoV-2 Positive|I HAD A RAPID TEST: Influenza Positive|I HAD A RAPID TEST: SARS-CoV-2 Positive|I HAD A RAPID TEST: Influenza AND SARS-CoV-2 Positive|I had a rapid test: Result NEGATIVE
notes: A-cluster weeks only. Self-reported test result; no laboratory linkage.

question_stem_en: Have you had a flu shot this season (from September 2025 onward)?
explanatory_text_en: Note: Select only one option.
answer_options_en: No, I haven't / I don't plan to.|Yes, I did.
notes: Weekly re-ask of vaccination status; allows uptake after the registration form.

question_stem_en: When did you get the flu shot?
explanatory_text_en: Note: Information needed to assess vaccine effectiveness (difference in getting sick between vaccinated and unvaccinated). Select only one option.
notes: Response set stops at W4/2026 exactly as on the registration form; vaccinations after W4/2026 have no code.
